description: This file defines deprecated custom operation APIs for PyTorch, including the CustomOp class, registration functions, and utility methods for handling custom operators, schemas, and autograd kernels.

classes.name: CustomOp
classes.description: A deprecated class representing a custom operator, with methods for registration, implementation, and autograd kernel handling.

classes.name: FuncAndLocation
classes.description: A dataclass holding a function and its source code location.

methods.name: warn_deprecated
methods.description: Issues a deprecation warning about torch._custom_op.

methods.name: custom_op
methods.description: Decorator for defining a custom operator, issues deprecation warning, and registers the operator.

methods.name: _register_autograd_kernel_indirection
methods.description: Registers autograd kernel indirection for a CustomOp.

methods.name: _register_impl
methods.description: Registers an implementation for a specific device type or backend.

methods.name: _get_impl
methods.description: Retrieves a registered implementation for a given kind.

methods.name: _has_impl
methods.description: Checks if an implementation for a given kind exists.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Destroys a CustomOp instance, removing it from global registry and associated attributes.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of a CustomOp.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Calls the underlying operator handle with provided arguments.

methods.name: impl
methods.description: Decorator to register an implementation for specified device types.

methods.name: impl_factory
methods.description: Registers an implementation for a factory function.

methods.name: impl_abstract
methods.description: Decorator to register an abstract implementation.

methods.name: _check_can_register_backward
methods.description: Validates if backward registration is permissible based on schema.

methods.name: impl_save_for_backward
methods.description: Decorator to register a save_for_backward function for autograd.

methods.name: impl_backward
methods.description: Decorator to register a backward function for autograd.

methods.name: find_ophandle_or_throw
methods.description: Finds an operator handle or throws an error if not found.

methods.name: validate_namespace
methods.description: Validates that a namespace string is valid and not reserved.

methods.name: validate_schema
methods.description: Validates that a schema is supported for custom ops.

methods.name: parse_qualname
methods.description: Parses a qualified operator name into namespace and name.

methods.name: validate_device_type
methods.description: Validates that a device type is supported.

methods.name: supported_param
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is supported for custom op registration.

methods.name: validate_function_matches_schema
methods.description: Ensures a function's signature matches a given schema.

methods.name: report_error_callback
methods.description: Handles error reporting for missing or unsupported implementations.

methods.name: custom_op_from_existing
methods.description: Creates a CustomOp from an existing operator.

methods.name: get_op
methods.description: Retrieves a default operator or raises an error if not found.

methods.name: _find_custom_op
methods.description: Finds a custom op by qualified name, optionally checking torch library.

methods.name: get_abstract_impl
methods.description: Retrieves the abstract implementation of a custom op if available.

methods.name: _custom_op_with_schema
methods.description: Creates a CustomOp with a specific schema and registers autograd indirection.
